meta.name: add-dial-number
meta.description: Add another phone number to an existing Dial channel — a second (or third) public line for the agent, so one NanoClaw install answers SMS and AI voice calls on multiple numbers. Use when Dial is already installed and the operator wants an additional number (e.g. a personal line plus a support line). Requires the Dial channel to already be installed (see /add-dial).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让同一安装接听多个号码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要给现有直线添加额外接听号码
copy.tagline_en: Answer calls on multiple numbers from a single installation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a Dial channel and need to add another number

howto.what: 给已经装好 Dial 通道的 NanoClaw 再加一个电话号码,同一个安装可以同时用多个号码收发短信和 AI 语音通话。每个号码是独立的分线程线路,回复从收到消息的那个号码发出。
howto.when: 当 Dial 通道已经安装好、你想再给 agent 加一个号码时使用(例如个人线之外再加一条客服线)。Dial 还没装的话,要先运行 /add-dial。

say.text: 这条新线路就叫 Support,允许任何人给它发消息(public)。
say.note: 决定谁能主动向这条线路发起对话。

say.text: 列出这个 Dial 账户现在已有的号码。
say.note: 先看账户里有哪些号码,方便挑一个没接入的。

howto.what_en: With Dial already installed, add a second or third phone number to your NanoClaw so it answers SMS and AI voice calls on multiple numbers. Each number is its own threaded line; replies leave from the number that received the message.
howto.when_en: Use when the Dial channel is already installed and you want an extra number for the agent, e.g. a personal line plus a support line. If Dial isn't installed, run /add-dial first.

say_en.text: Add another Dial number, +14155550123, wired to the support agent group.
say_en.note: Checks the number belongs to your account first.

say_en.text: Name this new line Support and allow anyone to text it (public).
say_en.note: Sets who may start conversations on this line.

say_en.text: List the Dial numbers already on this account.
say_en.note: Shows the account's numbers so you can pick one.
